headlines.title: לאחר קביעת יו"ר הכנסת לא לקיים הצבעה חוזרת: נתניהו החליט להשאיר את תפקיד המבקר בלי איוש
headlines.snippet: Following the Knesset Speaker's decision not to hold a repeat vote, Netanyahu has decided to leave the ombudsman position vacant. The Knesset Speaker refused to hold new elections for the role, despite a court order, and coalition party leaders urged defiance of the ruling.

headlines.title: שר הביטחון כ"ץ: "אם איראן תתקוף את ישראל - היא תספוג מהלומה מוחצת"
headlines.snippet: Defense Minister Katz stated that if Iran attacks Israel, it will suffer a crushing blow. This comes amid reports of drone attacks in Bahrain, missile launches by Iran towards Aqaba, and alleged US bombings in Iran.
headlines.title_he: שר הביטחון כ"ץ: "אם איראן תתקוף את ישראל - היא תספוג מהלומה מוחצת"

headlines.snippet: Trump warned of a massive attack on Iran, while Tehran reportedly struck targets in the Gulf. Kuwait reported a contained fire caused by an attack on its border, and Bahrain came under Iranian fire.

headlines.title: More than 4,200 Israelis storm Al-Aqsa Mosque in Jerusalem
headlines.snippet: Over 4,200 Israelis stormed the Al-Aqsa Mosque in Jerusalem, accompanied by settlers and far-right groups under heavy police protection.

headlines.title: US House votes to limit Iran war for first time since ceasefire breakdown
headlines.snippet: The US House of Representatives voted to limit Iran war powers for the first time since a ceasefire breakdown. However, the Senate failed to pass a related War Powers resolution.
